_comment: Config-2026 displacement map. Strategy: find posts where someone TEACHES a SPECIFIC tool Figma now displaces, using an engagement hook ('comment and I'll send the guide'). The commenters asking for that tool's guide are doing -- the hard way, in an external tool -- exactly what a new Figma feature now does natively, so they are in-market for Figma. Each query names the displaced tool + a guide/tutorial asset + a comment/DM bait modifier. `tool_keywords` are the clean names used to confirm a discovered post actually mentions a displaced tool (whole-word match).
